message: Version 0.5.5 is a signed update proof release that verifies the new stable signing baseline can upgrade from v0.5.4 to v0.5.5.
releaseNotes: Signed update proof: this release keeps the stable GitHub Actions signing key introduced in v0.5.4, publishes a v0.5.5 APK artifact for public update-feed release testing, and adds extra update dialog scroll padding so long update details remain visible above the action buttons.
